settings.title: We search inventory
settings.description: Edmonton, Richmond, and St-Eustache warehouses are checked against your request.

settings.title: We source if needed
settings.description: For items outside our regular catalogue, we reach out to our supplier network, including Brother and Lexmark.

settings.title: You get a quote
settings.description: Your CSR confirms price, quantity available, and expected delivery date before you commit.

settings.title: Order is placed
settings.description: Once approved, it ships from the nearest warehouse or direct from the supplier.

settings.hero_title: Can't find it in stock? We'll still get it to you.
settings.hero_description: Search any SKU to check live availability. If it's backordered, discontinued from our shelf, or a low-volume item we don't normally carry, submit a request and a CSR will source it and confirm pricing and lead time.
settings.lookup_placeholder: Enter SKU, brand + model, or item description
settings.form_description: If your item shows as out of stock or isn't listed, give us the details below. We'll check all three warehouses and our supplier network before quoting you a lead time.
settings.item_placeholder: e.g. Brother TN-660, or 'toner for HP LaserJet M404'
settings.notes_placeholder: Compatible vs. OEM preference, budget range, project details, etc.
settings.submit_note: A CSR will confirm pricing and availability before any order is placed — this request doesn't commit you to purchase.
settings.contact_card_title: Prefer to talk to a CSR directly?
settings.contact_card_description: Reach out to the team closest to you and reference 'special order' so it routes correctly.
